scope: All unresolved HeII lines with Lyα ≥5σ, observed HeII/Lyα ≥0.1, FWHM <900 km/s, no reported ≥3σ metal component; unknown coverage retained. All unresolved spectral or imaging EW0 lower bounds >240 Å. Genuine source streams only. 1.25 arcsec cones.
rule: Discovery table status is a crossmatch result. Only complete adjudications in vetted.jsonl.gz can revise the first-pass outcome. Stable per-release key: row_index, channel, stream, wave.hex().
catalogs: DESI DR1 native iron Redrock files
